source_title: TDOT Oversize/Overweight Permits (Rules 1680-07-01, rev. May 2018; Tenn. Code 55-7-205)
verify_reasons: Live sourcing partially blocked: tn.gov TDOT pages and the TDOT FAQ PDF returned HTTP 403 / connection-reset, but the codified rule 1680-07-01 (May 2018) was read via the Cornell LII mirror — superload thresholds and the single-trip/overweight fee are rule-sourced from it. The escort-width/length matrix is cross-referenced (only the roof-truss and discretionary law-enforcement escort provisions are quoted directly in the rule); confirm exact escort configuration with the TDOT OS/OW permit office.
Single-trip permit validity period and the per-axle weight table were not confirmed from an official source; validity_days left null.
Semitrailer legal length (53') is the national default; Tennessee statutory length is cited via cross-reference.

superload_thresholds.note: Tennessee superload = width over 16', height over 15'6", or gross over 165,000 lbs (length alone is NOT a superload trigger). Overweight superloads pay a bridge-evaluation fee: $100 (165,001-250,000 lbs), $300 (250,001-500,000 lbs), actual cost over 500,000 lbs. THP escort required over 18' wide (Interstate/federal-aid) or over 18' high (any highway).

width.note: 12'7"-14': 1 rear escort on Interstate/4-lane, 1 front on 2-lane (on 2-lane, loads over 10' wide need 1 escort unless pavement exceeds 24' excluding shoulders)
14'-16' wide: front + rear escorts on all roads; over 14' wide adds a $10 permit surcharge
over 16' wide is superload — front + rear civilian escorts, THP coordination
THP police escort required 18'+ wide on Interstate/federal-aid highway (min 2 officers, 4 hr min, $65/hr + $0.13/mile)

height.note: over 15' high (where approved): 1 front escort with height pole
THP police escort required 18'+ high on any highway

length.note: 85'-120': 1 rear escort (75'-85' requires amber light on rear only, no escort)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip oversize permit from $20 base (width tiers approx $20/$30 with a per-foot add over width). Over 14' wide adds +$10. Overweight = $20 + $0.06 per ton-mile over legal weight (rule 1680-07-01). Superloads also pay a bridge-evaluation fee: $100 (165,001-250,000 lbs), $300 (250,001-500,000 lbs), actual cost over 500,000 lbs. THP escort (superload) minimum 2 officers x 4 hrs at $65/hr + $0.13/mile.
single_trip.note: Fee starts at $20; overweight adds bridge-evaluation fees by weight bracket. Permit validity days not confirmed from an official TDOT source this run.

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset
Monday through Saturday; no Sunday travel for oversize loads
Rush-hour curfew (85'+ length or over 12'6" width): 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m. weekdays
No travel on major holidays (New Year's, Good Friday, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas)
Loads over 10' wide and/or 75' long require 'Oversize Load' signs at front and rear
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs (single axle 20,000 / tandem 34,000, Federal Bridge Formula on tridem/quad). A mobile home up to 14' wide needs no more than one following escort (and no lead) on the Interstate/4+-lane system.

tn.gov TDOT pages were 403-blocked this run; superload thresholds and fees were read from rule 1680-07-01 via the Cornell LII mirror, and the escort-width/length matrix cross-referenced from Tenn. Code 55-7-205 and published TDOT permit summaries. Note: the old tnoversize.com portal is DNS-dead — the current portal is TNTRIPS (tntrips.tdot.tn.gov).
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
